Container.Name: riven-backend
Container.Overview: [b]Riven Media Management Engine[/b][br][br] [b][span style='color: #E2211C;']⚠️ MANDATORY PREREQUISITES:[/span][/b][br] 1. [b]User Script:[/b] Run a script at Array Start: [i]mount --make-shared /mnt/vmdisk[/i].[br] 2. [b]Slave Mode:[/b] Set the /library path to [b]RW: Slave[/b].[br] 3. [b]Permissions:[/b] If logs show 'Permission Denied', run [i]chown -R 99:100 /mnt/vmdisk/appdata/riven[/i] in terminal.

Config.Name: Path: /library
Config.Description: The virtual FUSE mount point. Ensure host path is made 'shared' via user script and set to RW:Slave.

Config.Name: RIVEN_DATABASE_HOST
Config.Description: Replace PASS with your Postgres password.

Config.Name: RIVEN_API_KEY
Config.Description: 32-char hex key from riven.tv/generator. Must match Frontend API key.

Config.Name: RIVEN_FORCE_ENV
Config.Description: Forces environment variables to override database settings.
